# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest RDP123 release only.

| Release | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest | Yes |
| Older releases | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in a public issue.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting][report] and include:

- the affected RDP123 version;
- a description of the impact;
- steps to reproduce the problem;
- a proof of concept, logs, or screenshots when available;
- any known mitigations.

Do not include credentials or data from real remote systems. You should receive
an acknowledgement within seven days. Security reports will remain private
until a fix is available and affected users have had reasonable time to update.

[report]: https://github.com/asd123ch/rdp123/security/advisories/new
